capabilities: Mirror the active note live in a Magzdown reading pane with 500ms debounce
Render YAML frontmatter title, author, and date as a byline with reading time
Apply eight magazine-genre typographic presets and two scroll or paginated layouts
Configure color mode, layout, style preset, and embed URL in settings
Show a recovery message with retry when the reader fails to load
disambiguation: Not a tool for downloading or importing magazine articles; it renders your own vault notes in a magazine-style reading pane.
extras: Desktop-only (Obsidian Mobile lacks needed iframe support); requires an internet connection since the reader loads from magzdown.com; the plugin sends active note content and title/author/date frontmatter to magzdown.com via postMessage, though nothing is stored server-side; Pro features (extra themes, fonts, PDF/EPUB export) live on the webapp and are not needed for the plugin's core reading flow; the listing carries an 'not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff' notice.
problem: Obsidian's editor and preview use plain, functional typography with no immersive, print-grade reading mode for enjoying long-form notes.
summary: Embeds the magzdown.com reader in a side pane that mirrors the active note live as a magazine-style, typographically styled reading view.
